title: English Practice Quiz 0995
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: At an airport, where do you collect your checked suitcase?
questions.explanation: Checked luggage is collected at the baggage claim area.

questions.question: The staff ___ discussing the new schedule.
questions.explanation: Staff can take a plural verb when referring to the individual members of a group.

questions.question: A 'destination' is the place where you ___.
questions.explanation: Destination means the place someone is travelling to.

questions.question: Which instruction means turn to the left at the next road?
questions.explanation: Take the next left is a clear direction to turn left at the next road.

questions.question: She asked me where I ___ the previous evening.
questions.explanation: In reported questions with a past reporting verb, the past perfect can express an earlier past visit.

questions.question: A 'reservation' at a hotel is ___.
questions.explanation: A reservation is an arrangement made in advance.

questions.question: How can you ask for the price politely?
options: How much does this cost, please?
questions.explanation: This is a complete and courteous question about cost.

questions.question: The children enjoyed ___ in the garden.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund ending in -ing.

questions.question: Your train ticket shows the wrong date. What should you do?
options: Contact the ticket office for help
questions.explanation: The ticket office can verify the booking and advise on a correction.

questions.question: If a train is 'delayed', it is ___.
options: not leaving or arriving on time
questions.explanation: Delayed means later than the scheduled time.
